jobs.title: EDA Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight
is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning
culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Keysight is a leading provider of Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software used by communications and semiconductor manufacturers, chip designers, and R&D organizations around the world. Our portfolio, including ADS, RFPro, SystemVue, IC-CAP, and other advanced solutions, helps engineers model, simulate, and optimize increasingly complex electronic designs. Keysight’s EDA experts work alongside customers to solve demanding technical challenges, accelerate innovation, and bring breakthrough technologies to market with greater confidence.

As an EDA Customer Success Manager
, you will serve as the technical and strategic partner for a select portfolio of Keysight’s largest enterprise customers. You will develop a deep understanding of each customer’s design environment, technical priorities, and business objectives, then lead a coordinated customer-success strategy that expands adoption and makes Keysight solutions an integral part of their design workflows.

You will own the technical customer relationship across engineering teams and senior technical leaders, working closely with account managers, solutions engineers, services, support, and product experts. You will lead technical review meetings, adoption programs, customer training, design-flow initiatives, evaluations, and new-product introductions. You will also help customers overcome technical barriers while bringing their requirements, product feedback, and emerging needs back into Keysight.

Success in this role means helping customers realize measurable value from their Keysight investment through stronger design workflows, increased software usage, successful adoption of new capabilities, and lasting technical partnerships that support retention and expansion.

This is an opportunity for an accomplished EDA professional who wants to combine deep technical expertise with customer leadership, business insight, and program ownership. You will do more than support software: you will help influence how leading engineering organizations solve complex design challenges while shaping the future of Keysight’s software strategy.

Responsibilities

Develop and lead technical customer-success plans that align Keysight’s EDA solutions with each customer’s design workflows, engineering priorities, and business objectives.
Build trusted relationships with engineers, senior technical leaders, and executive stakeholders across strategic enterprise accounts.
Drive software adoption through a regular cadence of technical training, lunch-and-learns, office hours, workshops, and other customer-engagement programs.
Increase license utilization by helping customers fully use their base subscription capacity and, where appropriate, expand their use of available peak or extension license pools.
Make Keysight solutions an integral part of customers’ approved design flows by identifying technical gaps, overcoming resistance to change, and guiding the adoption of new tools, workflows, and capabilities.
Maintain deep knowledge of Keysight’s EDA portfolio and provide credible technical guidance during customer discussions, product evaluations, benchmarks, and complex design engagements.
Develop a thorough understanding of each customer’s design environment, including its workflows, technical challenges, software usage, organizational priorities, and opportunities for broader adoption.
Stay actively engaged in customers’ ongoing design and technical activities, including holding on-site or virtual office hours to help engineering teams address design issues.
Lead Technical Review Meetings (TRMs) and communicate customer progress, risks, requirements, and opportunities to customer stakeholders and internal Keysight teams.
Coordinate solutions engineers, services, support, product specialists, and other subject-matter experts to address customer needs, prioritize work, and ensure commitments are completed.
Serve as the voice of the customer to the Keysight Factory, communicating software defects, product requirements, and enhancement opportunities to Keysight’s product and development organizations and helping drive them toward resolution.
Promote new products, features, and New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives through customer events, technical demonstrations, evaluations, and design-flow engagements.
Advance key Keysight technology initiatives, including 5G, RF and Microwave (RFMW), High-Speed Digital (HSD), photonics, and other emerging design technologies, by connecting new capabilities to relevant customer challenges and workflows.
Identify and develop opportunities for design-flow wins, additional license adoption, services engagements, and broader deployment of Keysight solutions across customer teams and locations.
Partner with account managers and technical teams to develop account plans, customer strategies, and coordinated coverage that support adoption, retention, and account growth.
Measure and communicate customer outcomes, including proof of value, software adoption, usage growth, design-flow wins, customer health, retention, and expansion.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent university education in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical field.
Typically, eight or more years of relevant engineering, applications engineering, or EDA industry experience, consistent with the scope and technical leadership expected at the Expert level.
Five or more years of hands-on engineering experience using EDA software to model, simulate, analyze, or solve real-world electronic design problems. This experience should involve directly working with the tools, not solely managing projects, selling software, or supporting customers who use them.
Specialized technical depth in one or more relevant areas, such as RF and microwave design, RFIC, electronic system-level design, high-speed digital, semiconductor design, or process design kits (PDKs). Strong RF or microwave expertise is particularly valued.
Demonstrated ability to understand complex customer design flows, identify technical gaps, troubleshoot design challenges, and lead or perform software evaluations and benchmarks.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineering users, senior technical leaders, executive stakeholders, and internal product teams.
Experience leading complex technical projects or programs across multiple contributors, functions, and priorities, including coordinating work without direct managerial authority.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, follow through on commitments, and collaborate effectively within a cross-functional team environment.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25–40% to customer locations, technical meetings, and adoption events.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical field.
Significant hands-on experience with Keysight EDA solutions such as ADS, RFPro, SystemVue, IC-CAP, or related tools.
Experience working in complex enterprise engineering environments or supporting large, strategically important customer accounts.
Customer-facing experience in applications engineering, technical consulting, customer success, solutions engineering, or a similar role.
Experience integrating EDA tools into established customer design flows and driving adoption across multiple engineering teams or locations.
Broad knowledge across multiple EDA technologies, combined with the ability to identify and engage the appropriate specialists when deeper expertise is required.

Careers Privacy Statement

Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Keysight Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

Pay Transparency

The level of role will be based on applicable experience, education, and skills. Most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the Salary Range listed below.

California Bay Area Pay Range: Minimum $215,180 – Maximum $358,630

Note: For other locations, pay ranges will vary by region

Life, Accident, Disability insurance
Business Travel Accident and Business Travel Health

Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays
Paid Family Leave

jobs.title: Graduate Town Planner - Community Development - 2027 (Cambridge)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

With Every Community, Stantec Redefines What’s Possible.

Application Deadline: Recruitment is ongoing. Please apply as soon as possible as the advert may close once we have sufficient applicants.

The Opportunity

Join our 2027 Graduate Programme as a Graduate Town Planner
in our Cambridge
office, where you'll be part of a market-leading Community Development discipline.

About The Role

As a Stantec Graduate Town Planner, you'll join a collaborative team of 25 professionals and fellow graduates, developing your expertise within a creative and interdisciplinary environment. You'll gain exposure to a wide variety of projects across the residential, commercial and environmental sectors, supporting work from initial research and site appraisals through to planning applications, community engagement, plan promotion and planning appeals.

You'll contribute to the delivery and coordination of projects, working closely with colleagues from a range of disciplines to help ensure successful outcomes. Our Town Planning team specialises in large-scale, complex mixed-use and residential-led developments across the North West, including new communities, garden villages, regeneration projects, environmental initiatives and major infrastructure schemes.

This role offers excellent opportunities to broaden your planning knowledge, build professional skills and gain experience in multidisciplinary project delivery while being supported by experienced colleagues throughout your development.

We are committed to supporting employees in achieving relevant professional qualifications and accreditation.
The applicable professional qualification for this role is with the The Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI).

Your Impact

Day To Day, You'll Be

Undertaking planning research and site appraisals to support project development.
Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications.
Supporting community engagement and stakeholder consultation activities.
Contributing to the promotion of local plans and planning policy responses.
Assisting with planning appeals and the preparation of supporting documentation.
Working on a diverse range of residential, commercial and environmental projects.

Take a look at our Infrastructure business line here: Infrastructure Planning | Stantec , and review the career journey of some of our early careers professionals here: Career Stories | Stantec

About You

At Stantec, we value your potential over past experience. Along with a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in an RTPI accredited degree, a knowledge of Adobe, Microsoft office plus sketch up and design would be beneficial, and a keen interest in working in the Infrastructure sector, you'll be:

A Perseverer - You stay composed in the face of setbacks, approaching challenges with confidence and determination.
An Adapter - You’re able to remain calm in new and changing situations, comfortably switching between a variety of dynamic and exciting tasks.
A Focused Individual - You focus on what matters, tuning out distractions to perform effectively in any situation.
A Collaborator - You work effectively with lots of different people, considering others’ perspectives to shape better outcomes.
An Eager Learner - You learn from your experiences and the world around you, using this knowledge to anticipate how situations may unfold.

Please note, we ask our graduates to come into the office 4 days per week, to ensure that you receive sufficient time with your team and receive the appropriate level of support.

Applicants must have an unconditional right to live and work in the UK for an indefinite period without limitation.

Why Join Us?

What We Can Offer You

A competitive salary
Private medical insurance
A range of benefits, including holiday buy and sell, group income protection and life assurance
Permanent employment contract to demonstrate our commitment to your long-term career at Stantec
Professional progression plan, supporting you to gain professional chartership
A supportive and collaborative team environment and Early Careers peer group and wider ERG network (see more on our ERGs here: Stantec Employee Resource Groups )

Please take a look at our Graduate FAQs (
Graduate Application FAQs
) if you have any questions. We look forward to receiving your application!

#StantecNextGen #StantecCareers #UKGraduate

About Stantec

The Stantec community unites more than 34,000 employees working in over 450 locations across 6 continents. We have been working with our clients and communities in the UK for over 150 years. We plan, design, deliver and manage the development and infrastructure needed to support the creation of sustainable, healthy and prosperous communities.

Our teams provide effective and relevant solutions, translating our clients’ vision into valued consents, deliverable plans for projects and programmes, and efficient designs for delivery, based on technical excellence and deep market insights. We deal with today’s challenges, but also keep a fairer, better tomorrow in sight, looking at how we deliver clean growth, support radical changes in our economy and meet the needs of future communities.

Stantec provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for future and current employment and prohibit discrimination on the grounds of race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression. We prohibit discrimination in decisions concerning recruitment, hiring, referral, promotion, compensation, fringe benefits, job training, terminations or any other condition of employment. Stantec is in compliance with laws and regulations and ensures equitable opportunities in all aspects of employment.

Building an inspired, inclusive work environment that attracts, supports, and develops world-class talent is a crucial key to our success. If you are excited by this role but worry that your experience doesn’t exactly align, we encourage you to apply.

At Stantec we want you to perform your best at every stage of the recruitment process and are committed to ensuring it is accessible to all. If you need any support or require adjustments to be made then please contact [email protected] and we will talk to you about how we can support you.

jobs.title: Senior Town Planner
jobs.description:
Location/s:
Bristol or Cardiff; UK

Recruiter contact:
Steven Johnston

Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices.

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant.

About The Division

Environmental and social considerations are central to Mott MacDonald’s Purpose and its offerings across all sectors and territories. Our environment and social business provides essential services and innovative solutions which anticipate our clients' needs across all sectors.

Overview Of The Role

We are seeking an enthusiastic Senior Town Planner, who is up for the challenge of infrastructure delivery to join our expanding town planning team. You will be based in either Cardiff or Bristol supporting us in the delivery of a range of major infrastructure projects. We need a driven individual to support and grow our capabilities in providing strategic advice and securing planning approvals and consents across a range of sectors, including rail, defence, energy generation, energy and water infrastructure, climate resilience, education, health, housing, employment, mixed-use regeneration and waste focused schemes.

You will be responsible for supporting and helping to drive the growth of our offer in Wales and the SW of England, developing relationships with colleagues across the business, you will have a particular focus on forging links and growing opportunities within your region. You will be working alongside the full range of technical disciplines Mott MacDonald offers on some of the largest, most complex, challenging and exciting infrastructure and development projects in the UK. These will cover multiple sectors including energy, water, transport and the built and natural environment, for clients including Network Rail, Transport for Wales (TfW), Associated British Ports, Welsh Water, Wessex Water, South West Water, National Highways, National Grid, Environment Agency, NHS, Government Departments such as the Department for Education (DfE) and a range of local authorities.

Key responsibilities and duties include:
Working as part of the planning team to deliver a range of planning projects, including working alongside and potentially project managing and leading other disciplines as part of a multi-disciplinary delivery team
Writing and reviewing planning deliverables to a very high standard. This includes the development of high level options appraisals, producing consenting strategies, planning policy preparation, providing clear and accurate consenting advice, preparing and reviewing documents for planning applications, TWAOs, DCOs, ICOs and other consents
Leading and co-ordinating the preparation of planning applications, including managing the inputs from more junior members of staff, colleagues from across the business and sub-consultants
Liaising with Local Planning Authorities / Statutory Consultees as necessary to ensure applications are registered and determined within a timely manner
Preparing inputs and potentially leading bids for new work
Supporting more junior members of staff in their chartership and professional development
Supporting the growth of the Wales and SW England Planning team in respect of developing the team within the region, liaising with current and potential clients for the business and raising the profile of the planning team both internally and externally across the region

Candidate specification

Requirements:
Degree and/or Masters in Town Planning
Extensive town planning experience
Chartered Member of the RTPI
Experience of preparing and submitting planning applications, drafting reports, feasibility studies, masterplans and regeneration strategies
Experience of working with a range of client bodies including both private sector and public sector
Previous experience of, and having an active role in the delivery of varied infrastructure, regeneration and environmental projects
Experience in overseeing, and/or project managing multidisciplinary projects
Experience of supporting and mentoring more junior members of the team
Experience of team working to support the delivery of projects
Experience of financial accountability for projects and delivery of projects within budget

If you meet 80% or more of what we’re looking for, please still apply. We understand not everyone will meet all the requirements, but you might have skills we didn’t know we need.

UK Immigration

Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

Agile working

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion

We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone
feels they can contribute.

AI Usage

At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

Accessibility

We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com
and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

We offer some fantastic benefits including:

Financial wellbeing

We match employee pension contributions between 4.5% and 7%.
Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long-term illness or injury.
Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.

Employee Ownership

Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long-term impact and contribution.
Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.
For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.

Health and wellbeing

Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.

Lifestyle

A minimum of 33-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers.
Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high-street retailers.

Enhanced family and carers leave

Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.
We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing.

Learning and development

Primary annual professional institution subscription.
A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options.

Networks, communities, and social outcomes

Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Gold Award holders in the MOD Employer Recognition Scheme, supported by our dedicated internal Armed Forces Network.
Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.

Apply now, or for more information about our application process, click here.

new_jobs.title: EDA Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight
is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning
culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Keysight is a leading provider of Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software used by communications and semiconductor manufacturers, chip designers, and R&D organizations around the world. Our portfolio, including ADS, RFPro, SystemVue, IC-CAP, and other advanced solutions, helps engineers model, simulate, and optimize increasingly complex electronic designs. Keysight’s EDA experts work alongside customers to solve demanding technical challenges, accelerate innovation, and bring breakthrough technologies to market with greater confidence.

As an EDA Customer Success Manager
, you will serve as the technical and strategic partner for a select portfolio of Keysight’s largest enterprise customers. You will develop a deep understanding of each customer’s design environment, technical priorities, and business objectives, then lead a coordinated customer-success strategy that expands adoption and makes Keysight solutions an integral part of their design workflows.

You will own the technical customer relationship across engineering teams and senior technical leaders, working closely with account managers, solutions engineers, services, support, and product experts. You will lead technical review meetings, adoption programs, customer training, design-flow initiatives, evaluations, and new-product introductions. You will also help customers overcome technical barriers while bringing their requirements, product feedback, and emerging needs back into Keysight.

Success in this role means helping customers realize measurable value from their Keysight investment through stronger design workflows, increased software usage, successful adoption of new capabilities, and lasting technical partnerships that support retention and expansion.

This is an opportunity for an accomplished EDA professional who wants to combine deep technical expertise with customer leadership, business insight, and program ownership. You will do more than support software: you will help influence how leading engineering organizations solve complex design challenges while shaping the future of Keysight’s software strategy.

Responsibilities

Develop and lead technical customer-success plans that align Keysight’s EDA solutions with each customer’s design workflows, engineering priorities, and business objectives.
Build trusted relationships with engineers, senior technical leaders, and executive stakeholders across strategic enterprise accounts.
Drive software adoption through a regular cadence of technical training, lunch-and-learns, office hours, workshops, and other customer-engagement programs.
Increase license utilization by helping customers fully use their base subscription capacity and, where appropriate, expand their use of available peak or extension license pools.
Make Keysight solutions an integral part of customers’ approved design flows by identifying technical gaps, overcoming resistance to change, and guiding the adoption of new tools, workflows, and capabilities.
Maintain deep knowledge of Keysight’s EDA portfolio and provide credible technical guidance during customer discussions, product evaluations, benchmarks, and complex design engagements.
Develop a thorough understanding of each customer’s design environment, including its workflows, technical challenges, software usage, organizational priorities, and opportunities for broader adoption.
Stay actively engaged in customers’ ongoing design and technical activities, including holding on-site or virtual office hours to help engineering teams address design issues.
Lead Technical Review Meetings (TRMs) and communicate customer progress, risks, requirements, and opportunities to customer stakeholders and internal Keysight teams.
Coordinate solutions engineers, services, support, product specialists, and other subject-matter experts to address customer needs, prioritize work, and ensure commitments are completed.
Serve as the voice of the customer to the Keysight Factory, communicating software defects, product requirements, and enhancement opportunities to Keysight’s product and development organizations and helping drive them toward resolution.
Promote new products, features, and New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives through customer events, technical demonstrations, evaluations, and design-flow engagements.
Advance key Keysight technology initiatives, including 5G, RF and Microwave (RFMW), High-Speed Digital (HSD), photonics, and other emerging design technologies, by connecting new capabilities to relevant customer challenges and workflows.
Identify and develop opportunities for design-flow wins, additional license adoption, services engagements, and broader deployment of Keysight solutions across customer teams and locations.
Partner with account managers and technical teams to develop account plans, customer strategies, and coordinated coverage that support adoption, retention, and account growth.
Measure and communicate customer outcomes, including proof of value, software adoption, usage growth, design-flow wins, customer health, retention, and expansion.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent university education in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical field.
Typically, eight or more years of relevant engineering, applications engineering, or EDA industry experience, consistent with the scope and technical leadership expected at the Expert level.
Five or more years of hands-on engineering experience using EDA software to model, simulate, analyze, or solve real-world electronic design problems. This experience should involve directly working with the tools, not solely managing projects, selling software, or supporting customers who use them.
Specialized technical depth in one or more relevant areas, such as RF and microwave design, RFIC, electronic system-level design, high-speed digital, semiconductor design, or process design kits (PDKs). Strong RF or microwave expertise is particularly valued.
Demonstrated ability to understand complex customer design flows, identify technical gaps, troubleshoot design challenges, and lead or perform software evaluations and benchmarks.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineering users, senior technical leaders, executive stakeholders, and internal product teams.
Experience leading complex technical projects or programs across multiple contributors, functions, and priorities, including coordinating work without direct managerial authority.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, follow through on commitments, and collaborate effectively within a cross-functional team environment.
Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25–40% to customer locations, technical meetings, and adoption events.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technical field.
Significant hands-on experience with Keysight EDA solutions such as ADS, RFPro, SystemVue, IC-CAP, or related tools.
Experience working in complex enterprise engineering environments or supporting large, strategically important customer accounts.
Customer-facing experience in applications engineering, technical consulting, customer success, solutions engineering, or a similar role.
Experience integrating EDA tools into established customer design flows and driving adoption across multiple engineering teams or locations.
Broad knowledge across multiple EDA technologies, combined with the ability to identify and engage the appropriate specialists when deeper expertise is required.

Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Keysight Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

Assisting with planning appeals and the preparation of supporting documentation.
Working on a diverse range of residential, commercial and environmental projects.

Experience of supporting and mentoring more junior members of the team

We are seeking an enthusiastic and capable Senior or Principal Town Planner, who is up to the challenge of growing and developing a team of Town Planners ideally at our office in the heart of Manchester. WE also have offices in Altrincham, Leeds and Liverpool, so candidates with a preference for these offices will also be considered. You will be responsible for growing our presence within the Manchester market, developing relationships with colleagues across the business, with a particular focus on developing links within your city region.

We are seeking a driven individual to support us in the delivery of a range of major projects. To support and grow our capabilities in providing strategic advice and securing planning approvals across a range of sectors, including rail, defence, energy generation, energy and water infrastructure, climate resilience, education, health, housing, employment, mixed-use regeneration and waste focused schemes.

You will be working alongside the full range of technical disciplines Mott MacDonald offers on some of the largest, most complex and exciting infrastructure and development projects in the UK. These will cover multiple sectors including energy, water, transport and the built and natural environment, for clients including Network Rail, Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM), United Utilities, National Highways, National Grid, Environment Agency, NHS, Government Departments such as the Department for Education (DfE) and a range of local authorities.

Key responsibilities and duties include:
Working as part of the planning team to deliver a range of planning projects, including working alongside and potentially project managing other disciplines as part of a multi-disciplinary team
Writing and reviewing planning deliverables to a very high standard. This includes high level options appraisals, developing and producing consenting strategies, planning policy preparation, providing clear and accurate consenting advice, preparing and reviewing documents for planning applications, TWAOs, DCOs and other consents
Responsible for leading the preparation and co-ordination of planning applications, including managing the inputs from more junior members of staff, colleagues from across the business and sub-consultants
Liaising with Local Planning Authorities / Statutory Consultees as necessary to ensure applications are registered and determined within a timely manner
Preparing inputs and potentially leading bids for new work
Supporting more junior members of staff in their chartership and professional development
Developing and driving the implementation of a growth strategy for the Manchester team, liaising with each of the relevant account leads to align with existing growth strategies for the business

Candidate specification

Requirements:
Degree and/or Masters in Town Planning
Extensive town planning experience across a range of consenting types, including the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Development Consent Order and Transport and Works Act Order processes
Chartered Member of the RTPI
Experience of leading the preparation and submission of planning applications, drafting reports, feasibility studies, masterplans and regeneration strategies
Experience of working with a range of client bodies including both private sector and public sector
Previous experience of, and having an active role in the delivery of varied infrastructure, regeneration and environmental projects
Experience in overseeing, and/or project managing multidisciplinary projects
Experience of supporting, managing or mentoring more junior members of the team
Experience of team working to support the delivery of projects
Experience of financial accountability for projects and delivery of projects within budget

If you meet 80% or more of what we’re looking for, please still apply. We understand not everyone will meet all the requirements, but you might have skills we didn’t know we need.
